The '''BTL-S3B Y-wing starfighter''' was a variant of the twin [[Engine/Legends|engined]] [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]] produced by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] as part of the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL]] line. Like the S3, the S3B was a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] two seater assault [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] manned by a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. The S3B had either twin [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] or twin laser cannons in place of the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] the S3 used for its turret, and particle cannons in place of the nose-mounted laster cannons. It was more successful than the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-A4 Y-wing]] variant.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The BTL-S3B was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Urquhart confirmed in [[2015]] on the [[TheForce.net]] that the S3B was both a nod to the two-seater Y-wings that appeared in ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'' and ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', and to the sources such as the [[Star Wars Battlefront (series)|''Star Wars: Battlefront'']] series that had Y-wings with blasters in their turrets.<ref name="TheForce.net">{{JCFCite|url=posts/52393157|board=Literature|thread=The Official Jason Fry Discussion Thread|user=Thrawn McEwok|date=2015-05-16}}</ref>
